imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts. The bathrobe guide uses three accurate category text links; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product image is required.

searchConsole.signal: Four homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.5, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster
searchConsole.decision: The sample is too small and queryless to support a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore uses one authority expansion and two unrelated evergreen explorations chosen from the complete inventory and recent-topic rotation.
searchConsole.ignored: The four homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or a repeated topic cluster.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow category text recommendations appear only on the bathrobe guide. The appointment and moving-day guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy doctor-visit preparation and follow-up file that combines the visit question, complete medicine list, symptom timeline, records, decision owner, teach-back and dated follow-up in one portable handoff.
authority.cluster: Health-record and well-run-life authority, with reciprocal paths from blood-pressure, medicine-cabinet, health-insurance and hair-change guides; the robe and moving-day pages also strengthen clothing-care and household-transition clusters.
authority.opportunity: Two qualified accuracy opportunities were logged for AHRQ patient-engagement educators and FMCSA Protect Your Move; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life and Style: how to prepare and close a medical appointment, how to choose a bathrobe by use and construction, and how to control a move's final handoff and first night. Only the apparel guide is commercial, and none follows the weak Search Console sample.
